scope: User-requested exploratory inferCNV within PDAC myeloid cells and SLC6A6 comparison; not a malignancy diagnosis
unit: author patient/sample label; clinical independence not recertified
input_population: Existing primary tumor selection; eligible matched-author-unit normal tissue myeloid cells added as calibration controls
reference_sampling: Stable SHA256-derived seed per cohort+author unit+role; at most200 T and200 B; split equally into training and heldout; max100 author malignant or normal-tissue myeloid control cells; all tumor myeloid retained
gene_order: GENCODE v36 GRCh38, autosomes only, duplicate gene symbols excluded
circularity_guard: Entire chromosome3 excluded from inferCNV; SLC6A6 on chr3 is read only for subsequent comparisons; no inference about chr3 CNV

classification.type: Analyst-defined exploratory score rule on inferCNV expression residuals; not inferCNV HMM or a validated malignancy classifier
classification.chromosome_score: absolute chromosome mean residual;at least50 retained genes per chromosome and at least15 usable chromosomes per unit
classification.thresholds: Heldout T/B 99th percentile for global/chr extremes and95th global for reference-like; when>=20 normal-tissue myeloid controls exist, use the larger lymphocyte/myeloid threshold; R quantile type8
classification.abnormal_per_variant: global score above99th percentile and at least2 chromosome extremes
classification.reference_like_per_variant: global score<=95th percentile and no chromosome extremes
classification.consensus_abnormal: Abnormal in all3 reference variants with at least2 shared extreme chromosomes having concordant directions
classification.interpretation: All classifications describe expression-derived CNV patterns, not confirmed malignant/normal identities; calibration controls are not independent validation

SLC6A6.normalization: log1p(10000*raw count/all-gene library size), using full library including chr3
SLC6A6.primary_comparison: CNV-abnormal-candidate minus reference-like myeloid within author unit
SLC6A6.minimum: 20 cells per group within unit and5 paired author units for inference
SLC6A6.test: Exact sign-flip permutation of equal-author-unit mean differences
SLC6A6.multiplicity: BH across evaluable primary cohort tests; planned family3; unevaluable cohorts retained
SLC6A6.composition_limit: Primary comparison not adjusted for myeloid subtype composition; subtype availability differs across cohorts

data_residency: All raw matrices, cell identities and author-unit values remain on server165; local/GitHub only scripts, parameters and aggregates
